name: Craft
description:
Productivity App for Notes, Tasks, and Docs. 

Craft isn’t just for one thing, it’s for your things.
	Docs
	Tasks
	Calendar
	Whiteboards
	Daily Notes

Write
From first thought to final form
	In Craft, your writing moves with you — capture ideas instantly across all your devices, then refine 	them when you’re ready. Transform quick iPhone notes into documents you’re proud to share.
	(Templates, Whiteboards, Write with AI, Publish & Share)

Organize
Structure That Adapts to Your Thinking
	Choose any approach that fits your mind: organize with spaces, folders and tags, or build rich 	databases with collections

Customization
Make it unmistakably yours
	Instantly transform your docs
	With over 100 ready-made styles, you can instantly shape the look and feel of your document — 	minimal, bold, creative, or calm. 	Pick a style to match your mood before you write, or change it later 	without losing your structure.

________________

Pricing
Your pace, your plan
Use it now and then, or integrate it into your daily flow.

Free
	Full access, great if you use it occasionally each week.
	NZ$0 /month

Plus
	Designed to effortlessly fit into your everyday flow.
	NZ$15.0 /month
